contracts.rule: 32-bit tokens at the entered CPR paths: -2 registers a class declaration and continues; -1 declares a class, then payload length; other negative values are class references after clearing the sign bit. Class declaration offsets are ARCH-relative. Positive tokens reference object identity at its payload-length field; zero is null. Probe only resolves previously entered object identities and backward missing-class references to explicit -1 declarations.

MDataNode begins a length string and signed32 datum type. Normal branch type0/17 consumes two archive objects/references; observed types1/10 consume a double. MListNode then reads signed32 child count and objects; MTrackList inserts an unsigned16 before that count. All entered MListNode/MTrackList payloads end exactly across ten templates.

Field type1 reads signed64,4 reads double,8 reads a length string,2 a bounded compound. All ten roots consume exactly. Attribute IDs are unique and Type/value field tags agree.
